results.title: Pipe Dream Furniture is rated "Great" with 3.9 / 5 on Trustpilot
results.content:
Considering 274 reviews, reviewers had a great experience with this company. Customers frequently praise the exceptional quality of the custom products, mentioning that the wooden materials feel very sturdy, look exceptionally stylish, and fit their specific spaces perfectly. Many people are also extremely happy with the remarkably helpful customer service provided by the team and the wonderfully straightforward online ordering process. However, some reviewers were not happy with frustrating delivery delays, unfulfilled shipping promises, long waiting times, and completely missing tracking updates. A few other people also felt that items occasionally arrived damaged, lacked proper assembly instructions, or came equipped with unsuitable installation fittings.See more [...] To make matters worse, I’ve now had THREE different joiners come out to try and assemble the counter. All three have said that there appear to be pieces missing and that they cannot properly assemble it without the correct information/instructions from Pipe Dream.  
  
This is a nearly £4,000 product and a major part of a coffee house I am trying to open. I’ve wasted time and money arranging joiners, and my opening preparations are now being affected simply because I cannot get anybody from the company to respond.  
  
What I find most frustrating is how quickly my messages were answered when I was looking to purchase, compared with the complete silence now that they have my payment. [...] Thank you for taking the time to share your experience. We are genuinely sorry to hear how frustrating this has been, particularly with your coffee house opening preparations depending on the counter being assembled.  
  
We completely understand your frustration, and we are sorry that you were left waiting for a response after being given specific timescales for when the information would be sent. Regardless of how busy we may be, we appreciate that you should have received an update rather than being left chasing us.

results.title: Pipedream Review: Automation Power, Pricing, and Use Cases
results.content:
Real user review about Pipedream on Product Hunt

Many reviewers appreciated the time saved, thanks to fast automation and pre-built integrations. Other positives include scalability, ease of handling growing workloads, and an active community that provides support and shares solutions.

On the other hand, common complaints center on the learning curve, especially for new users unfamiliar with APIs or serverless workflows. Some users report UX friction, such as confusing navigation or setup steps, and pricing uncertainty as usage grows. A few mention that documentation gaps can slow down onboarding.

Review Pipedream?

Reviewers describe Pipedream as an easy, fast way to build and run API workflows, from simple scripts to complex company automations. They repeatedly praise its developer-friendly UI, built-in integrations, custom code support, webhooks, scheduling, and the ability to go deeper when off-the-shelf components fall short. Support and community responsiveness also stand out. The few criticisms are narrow: some wanted missing integrations like Firebase or custom web3 triggers. Makers of Spine also say it beats building API connections from scratch.
